text: Completed by auditing and ratifying Gale's existing committed optional FFM boundary at d55fe2f97196a76ab7879e1a12f1e92403aeba06; no new native implementation was added. Gale already isolates JDK22+ NativeDMat and BLAS/LAPACK FFM artifacts from both cores, makes Arena ownership and heap/native copies explicit, runtime-discovers provider symbols, maps LAPACK info to typed errors, exposes no upcalls/callbacks, requires explicit native access, and never uses Linker.Option.critical heap access. Copy-inclusive JDK22 Apple ARM64/Accelerate receipts support only conservative provider-specific routing: square GEMM from n=512, LU/solve and symmetric eigen from n=128; GEMV, QR, and Cholesky remain disabled, and OpenBLAS/MKL/unknown defaults remain disabled pending their own sweeps. The retained losses include GEMM 0.25x at n=256, no GEMV crossover through n=2048, and QR scenario losses. In a clean isolated snapshot, JDK25 passed 3 NativeDMat tests, 21 BLAS/LAPACK tests, and FFM JMH compilation. Isolation scans found no java.lang.foreign references in either core and no critical linker option in the native modules. The dirty Gale worktree remained unchanged. Ravel docs now record the boundary and evidence; Ravel core retains primitive arrays and received no FFM, BLAS, or matrix API.
